title: keep, rename and replace
prompt: Use the workflow tool for these calls, one after another, and tell me each result in one sentence. 1. argv ["check"] with this script: let meta = #{ name: "wf-live-kept", description: "Kept by the live matrix" }; let r = agent("Reply with the word kept.", #{ label: "kept", agent_type: "wf-live-worker" }); complete(r.output); It returns a script_id. 2. argv ["keep","<script_id>"]. 3. The same keep again without --replace, which the engine refuses. 4. argv ["keep","<script_id>","--replace"]. 5. argv ["keep","<script_id>","--name","wf-live-kept-renamed"]. 6. argv ["run","wf-live-kept-renamed"]. Then end your turn.
